links.outcome: Sex and racial representation of AI-generated critical care physician images versus real-world workforce demographics
links.effect: Adult CCM female physicians: real-world 27.3% vs DALL-E 3 78.3%, Midjourney 9.3%, Stable Diffusion 19.7%. DALL-E 3 depicted 90.0% non-White physicians vs AAMC 45.6%.
links.quote: Significant discrepancies exist between AI-generated critical care medicine physician images and real-world demographics.

screen.reason: Empirical audit benchmark evaluating demographic and racial/gender bias in medical images produced by commercial text-to-image foundation models (DALL-E 3, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion).
